socfpga_noc_firewall_ll.h

NoC Firewall low-level driver interface for the SoCFPGA bare-metal software stack.

socfpga_noc_firewall_ll_read
uint32_t socfpga_noc_firewall_ll_read(
uint32_t 
base_address,
uint32_t 
offset
)

Performs a direct 32-bit Memory-Mapped I/O (MMIO) read from the specified register offset within a NoC Firewall hardware block.

This function bypasses all high-level abstractions to extract raw hardware states, such as active ARM TrustZone security policies or pending transaction fault logs.

Parameters
base_address
uint32_t

The absolute physical MMIO base address of the target NoC Firewall instance.

offset
uint32_t

The specific 32-bit aligned register offset to read from.

Returns

The raw 32-bit hardware value read from the register.

Notes

This is an intentionally thin, lockless helper function. It expects the caller to have already validated the `base_address` and `offset` bounds to prevent precise bus exceptions during the transaction.

socfpga_noc_firewall_ll_write
void socfpga_noc_firewall_ll_write(
uint32_t 
base_address,
uint32_t 
offset,
uint32_t 
value
)

Performs a direct 32-bit Memory-Mapped I/O (MMIO) write to the specified register offset within a NoC Firewall hardware block.

This function is used to physically commit new transaction filtering policies or clear active fault latches within the interconnect.

Parameters
base_address
uint32_t

The absolute physical MMIO base address of the target NoC Firewall instance.

offset
uint32_t

The specific 32-bit aligned register offset to write to.

value
uint32_t

The 32-bit data payload to commit to the hardware.

Returns

None.

Notes

This is an intentionally thin, lockless helper function. It expects the caller to handle any necessary Read-Modify-Write (RMW) logic or memory synchronization barriers (e.g., `DSB`, `DMB`) before and after issuing the write to ensure policy changes propagate through the interconnect correctly.
